group: ORDER: a list the record carries whose order no consumer reads
grounds: `required` (adapters.py:172) goes to three places only: review_ocr.coverage(), whose first statement is `required = sorted(set(required))` (review_ocr.py:80), so its `missing[:10]` and reasons do not depend on the caller's order; review_ocr.findings() `set(required)` (membership only); and the session record (adapters.py:220 -> run.py:491 -> RUN.json).
